annotations.title: Check services I use for breaches

description: Given up to 10 companies or services a person uses, say for each whether Teollimi has a reported breach, how many, and the latest one with what leaked. Absence of a record does not mean the service was never breached.

lang.description: Answer language: ko (Korean), en (English) or ja (Japanese). Defaults to the query's language, else English.
